observations: Page 25 contains the main bridge plan and longitudinal profile.
Page 27 contains Ramp-A and Ramp-B plan/longitudinal drawings with elevation axes.
Page 115 gives a 7.5 m Ramp-A cross-section and a shown 2.035 m structural depth.
The public raster does not yet support a sub-decimetre station-to-EUS registration or a complete deck-top profile.
